workflow.name: cs_auto_diag
workflow.description: 改 .cs 后自动跑 cs_diag，仅当含 [ERROR] 时注入诊断（after_tool 钩子；基于 changed_files 快照 diff 检测——run_python/MCP 等任何方式改了 .cs 都能触发；需先 ensure_lsp('csharp') 装配 csharp-lsp）

out.name: changed_files
out.description: [{"file":"a.cs","change":"new|modified|deleted"}]——工具调用前后 workspace mtime 快照 diff 的真实副作用（数组直传）

node.title: filter_cs
node.code: async def main(args) -> dict: ch = args.params.get("changed_files") or [] if isinstance(ch, str): # 兜底：上游若传了 JSON 字符串（旧工作流）也能解析 import json as _j try: ch = _j.loads(ch) except Exception: ch = [] # .cs 且 new/modified（deleted 无法诊断）；取全部但 plugin 单文件——按字母序取第一个 cs = sorted(str(c.get("file", "")) for c in ch if str(c.get("file", "")).lower().endswith(".cs") and c.get("change") in ("new", "modified")) has = bool(cs) more = f"（另有 {len(cs)-1} 个 .cs 改动未诊断）" if len(cs) > 1 else "" return {"has_cs": has, "first_file": cs[0] if cs else "", "note": more}

node.title: check_errors
node.code: async def main(args) -> dict: diag = args.params.get("diag") or "" has_err = "[ERROR]" in diag or "error" in diag.lower()[:2000] return {"has_err": has_err, "diag": diag}

node.title: format_inject
node.code: async def main(args) -> dict: d = (args.params.get("diag") or "")[:2000] f = args.params.get("file") or "" note = args.params.get("note") or "" return {"inject": True, "result": f"⚠️ OmniSharp 诊断 {f} 含错误{note}：\n{d}"}
